text_copy_copy_copy.text: SPECIFICATION OVERVIEW

text.text: Stryker’s Pulse Intelligent Delivery Platform is a full-circle product and fulfillment offering optimized for high volume foot and ankle procedures with the unique challenges of the ASC setting of care in mind. Pulse provides out-of-the-box, surgery-ready products, constantly tracks what you need, and facilitates replenishment of the appropriate product configuration so you never miss a beat.
Welcome to the future of orthopedic products and fulfillment

text_copy.text: The “one-size fits all” approach to orthopedic product and fulfillment services is outdated. Unique challenges call for more targeted solutions.

text.text: Save more with Pulse

text_copy_copy.text: The typical orthopedic facility is spending about $100,000 in forefoot sterilizationcosts per year.1 Pulse sterile inventory works against these costs, but the benefits don’t stop there.

text_652839079_copy.text:
• $90 cost reduction per case on forefoot sterilization2
  • 80% decreased need for instrument trays requiring sterilization2
  • 72% decreased packaging footprint compared to existing packaging3
  • 82% reduction in OR footprint compared to reusable instrument trays2

text.text: Worry less with Pulse

text_copy_copy.text: Missed or delayed surgeries are a real concern. According to both surgeons and administrators, the #1 challenge in the patient care experience is having the correct equipment on hand for every case.4

text_652839079_copy_.text:
Other challenges include:

  • Sterilization capacity
  • Staffing shortages
  • Lack of storage space
  • Cost constraints
  • Inventory management
  • Supply shortages

largeheadline_copy_c.line1: Pulse can help
largeheadline_copy_c.line2: RFID technology keeps a constant eye on your inventory and automatically triggers replenishment orders, so you never miss or delay a forefoot procedure due to sterility or supply changes.

text_1679885360_copy.text: The brands you love, now 100% sterile.

text_copy_copy.text:
DartFire Edge® Cannulated Screw System

DartFire Edge is Stryker’s latest innovation in cannulated screw technology. Headed and headless 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, and 4.0mm screws are available in a wide rage of thread options.

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Ortholoc® 3Di and Crosscheck Plating

Ortholoc 3Di and Crosscheck™ plating systems are now available through Pulse in fully sterile configurations for primary and revision MTP and Lapidus procedures.

Phalinx® Hammertoe
Phalinx Hammertoe is Stryker’s flagship solution for distal extremity fixation. Now, with Pulse, the entireprocedure can be completed from a single sterile box that could fit into your pocket.

text_copy_copy.text:
EasyFuse® Dynamic Compression System
EasyFuse is Stryker’s latest innovation in nitinol staple technology. EasyFuse delivers robust, dynamic fixation and a single set of sterile instruments that can be used for any implant option.
